ThingDef.label: disabled mech
ThingDef.description: A raider-pattern automatroid in hibernation mode, still clamped to the assembly cradle it was built on. The line that made it never got as far as locking its command authentication. A mechanitor can attempt to hack and control it.

ThingDef.label: disabled mech
ThingDef.description: A tachanka-pattern battle frame in hibernation mode, clamped into an assembly gantry with its fitting-out unfinished. Its command authentication has not been locked yet. A mechanitor can attempt to hack and control it.
